Having seen both, I prefer the first one — the toolbar with the **B**, italic, bullet, and link buttons.

Here's my honest reasoning: this second version works, and I like that I can see the finished version right next to what I'm typing. But it asks me to type little symbols — the stars and dashes and bracket things — to get the formatting, and I'd have to learn and remember what each one does. I'm not that kind of person; I just want to select a word and click a button to make it bold, the way I already do everywhere else. So the toolbar feels more like me.

The one nice thing from this version I'd love to keep: however I enter the formatting, I want the note to end up looking properly formatted when I read it back — the bold words bold, bullets as real bullets, and a link I can actually click. That result is what matters, and both got there.

So: go with the toolbar approach for entering it, and keep that clean formatted result on the card.
